description: A chat list after a desktop coding agent app: a New chat row, Pinned, chats by project or in one list, a sort, archive from a row, a plain thread hover card, and quiet one-line row decorations.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list them.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its chat.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a chat, or open one in a tab.
scopes.storage:local: Remember what you pinned and archived, and the sort.
